title: [Master]-Project consumption: partial invoicing of non-inventory items posts negative adjustment value entry to wrong Item Ledger Entry
summary: Fixed posting of negative adjustment value entries for partially invoiced non-inventory items in project consumption, which were incorrectly linked to the wrong item ledger entry.
key_points: Corrects incorrect item ledger entry association when posting adjustments for partially invoiced project consumption items
Affects purchase order posting logic across all localized versions
Includes new test cases to verify proper adjustment value entry posting
Resolves issue with non-inventory item handling in project scenarios
